name: Eosinophilic Fasciitis with Groove Sign

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: No formal universally accepted criteria; diagnosis based on clinical, laboratory, and histopathological findings

criteria.description: Symmetrical swelling and induration of the skin and subcutaneous fascia, often with groove sign
Peripheral blood eosinophilia (>500 cells/μL) during active disease
Full-thickness biopsy showing fascial thickening with inflammatory infiltrate rich in eosinophils
Visible or palpable linear depressions along veins due to fascial thickening
Lack of significant internal organ fibrosis differentiating from systemic sclerosis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of symmetrical skin and fascial thickening with peripheral eosinophilia and confirmatory fascial biopsy
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of systemic sclerosis and other scleroderma-like disorders

pathognomonic.notes: Typically affects limbs sparing hands and feet

pathognomonic.symptomName: Groove sign (linear skin depressions over veins)
pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic skin indentation along venous pathways

common.symptomName: Tenderness and pain of affected limbs
Restricted joint mobility due to fascial thickening

occasional.notes: Due to fascial thickening compressing median nerve

rare.symptomName: Erythema and peau d’orange skin changes

imaging: MRI showing fascial thickening and edema
other: Full-thickness skin and fascial biopsy showing eosinophilic infiltration and fibrosis

distinguishingFeatures: Skin involvement includes hands and face
Localized skin sclerosis without fascial involvement
Muscle weakness with elevated muscle enzymes

redFlags: Rapidly progressive skin induration with systemic symptoms
Development of joint contractures limiting mobility
Signs of internal organ involvement suggesting systemic sclerosis
references: Shulman LE. Diffuse fasciitis with eosinophilia: a new syndrome? Trans Assoc Am Physicians. 1974;87:70-86.
Lakhanpal S, Ginsburg WW, Michet CJ Jr, Doyle JA, Moore SB. Eosinophilic fasciitis: clinical spectrum and therapeutic response in 52 cases. Semin Arthritis Rheum. 1988;17(4):221-31.
Pinal-Fernandez I, Selva-O'Callaghan A, Grau JM. Diagnosis and classification of eosinophilic fasciitis. Autoimmun Rev. 2014;13(4-5):379-82.
